text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The skies have cleared so beautifully... 
Where will this radiant breeze guide us 
today?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, little round friends, are you heading 
out? It is wonderful weather for a stroll 
in the sky, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is the one beside you... a new companion? 
Hehe, you two seem quite close already—
Caaaat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard that a TV drama starring an 
umamusume actor was filming at the academy 
and came to watch... but Yamanin Zephyr 
wandered right into the shot.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So... you were filming right now. I 
apologize deeply for disturbing you...
choice_data_list:
I am so terribly sorry for my student's 
interruption!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Wait! That girl... she's got presence. 
What do you say, would you be willing to 
appear as an extra? You just have to walk 
and run a bit!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If it is something I can do, I shall try. 
This, too, must be the guidance of a 
whimsical wind.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... Zephyr-san, was it? Good work♪ Hey, 
hey, I was wondering... Were you talking 
to those sparrows just now?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The little round ones said they were 
going on a journey riding the breeze. They 
should be near the mountains by now.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you can even tell what birds are 
feeling! You might actually have quite a 
talent for acting, Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I do not know much about acting... Is that 
how it works?

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Getting into the heart of whoever 
you're playing is key. Well, doing that 
can be pretty tough though.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... that's where I've been 
struggling for this role. It's a story 
about an umamusume aiming for her debut, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't say I truly feel it in my gut, you 
know? Since... I never chose the path of 
running myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being an actor is truly a demanding 
pursuit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Starting the training scene, Cut 1! 
...Alright, Yamanin Zephyr-san, could you 
give us an easy lap around the track? It's 
just a rehearsal, so relax.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Then, here I go.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hahh!

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—?! What incredible intensity...! She's 
like a completely different person... Even 
though she was so gentle just a moment 
ago...!

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's how a real athlete runs... 
Something I've never known... It must be—!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Please tell me, Zephyr-san! What kind 
of feelings were driving you just now?!

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about while running to 
create a run that incredible?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ... A longing yearning... perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
On that day in my youth... I encountered 
the wind. A mythic gale faster and more 
splendid than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That wind, which never ceases blowing in 
my heart... still guides me even today.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I... I think I felt it too. Your... wind, 
Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This feeling of being unable to stand 
still... This is what a true—

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run with everything I've 
got...! I know I can grasp this feeling 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I sense a wind being summoned. 
Constantly flowing and circling... from 
one heart to another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The drama that aired later achieved high 
viewership ratings. Her running imbued 
with passionate longing resonated with 
many, sparking an unprecedented craze 
within Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list:
I heard a letter arrived from that lead 
actress?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A refreshing breeze reached me as 
well, carrying words full of hope.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
From now on, she too will blow a wind into 
someone else's heart.

text_block_list.name: Lead Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Zephyr-san! Thanks to you, I 
came closer to understanding how athletes 
truly feel! I'm sure this drama will turn 
out amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A mighty wind, indeed. That wind will 
surely continue to push you forward on 
your journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the filming wrapped up 
successfully. Thanks to Yamanin Zephyr, 
the lead umamusume had captured a truly 
authentic running performance.
